layer1.name: DrawQuest
layer1.one_liner: A daily drawing prompt app for iPad, for people who cannot draw.
layer1.description: Every day a new prompt; users drew a response with simple tools and shared it. Free, with paid coins for extra brushes and colours. Strong engagement among the users it had at t0.
layer1.outcome_note: Shut down despite good retention among existing users, because the paid-coin model produced too little revenue per user and the user base was not growing fast enough to compensate.
